fee_notes: Single Club: $39,500. Second or subsequent Club for existing franchisees: $34,500. VetFran qualified veterans: $34,500 ($5,000 discount). Area Development Agreement: $89,500 for first three Clubs, $25,000 per additional Club (applied toward per-Club franchise fee).
raw_excerpt: If you are acquiring franchise rights for a single Club, the initial franchise fee is $39,500. If you are an existing franchisee acquiring your second or subsequent Club, you are eligible for a reduced initial franchise fee of $34,500.
